options.name: label
options.description: Visible label and accessible name.

options.name: hideLabel
options.description: Visually hide the label; it remains the accessible name.

options.name: description
options.description: Help text referenced by aria-describedby.

options.name: mask
options.description: Pattern: 9 digit, a letter, * letter or digit, custom token characters, \ escapes; anything else is a literal.

options.name: tokens
options.description: Custom tokens { pattern, transform?, description? }; override built-ins with the same character.

options.name: value
options.description: Initial raw value (formatted text is accepted and parsed); also restored by reset().

options.name: minLength
options.description: Raw characters needed for a complete value (default: every slot).

options.name: name
options.description: Form field name (hidden input).

options.name: submit
options.description: What the hidden input and getFormValue() carry.

options.name: placeholder
options.description: Shown while empty and unfocused (default: the template with placeholder characters).

options.name: example
options.description: Example value read in the generated format hint.

options.name: formatHint
options.description: Replaces the generated format hint.

options.name: required
options.description: Empty value is invalid; shows the required indicator.

options.name: disabled
options.description: Disables the field.

options.name: readOnly
options.description: Focusable and submitted, not editable.

options.name: inputMode
options.description: Virtual keyboard hint (default numeric for digit-only masks).

options.name: autocomplete
options.description: Native autocomplete token.

options.name: direction
options.description: Text direction of the value.

options.name: validate
options.type: (value: string, context: { formattedValue: string; complete: boolean }) => string | null
options.description: Consumer validation (for example a checksum); return a message to mark the value invalid.

options.name: icons
options.description: Icon slot overrides.

options.name: validationTiming
options.description: When validation messages first appear; afterwards they update live.

options.name: placeholderChar
options.description: Character shown in empty slots while the template is visible.

options.name: showMaskOnFocus
options.description: Show the whole template while focused.

options.name: locale
options.description: Message locale.

properties.name: host
properties.description: Consumer host; its children are owned by the component.

properties.name: formattedValue
properties.description: The value with literals, up to the last filled slot.

properties.name: complete
properties.description: At least minLength (default every) slot is filled.

properties.name: validity
properties.description: { valid, error, message }; computed on every change.

properties.name: dirty
properties.description: Value differs from the initial value.

properties.name: touched
properties.description: Focus has left the control at least once.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Set from raw or formatted text; characters that fit no slot are dropped (no event).

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge and apply options; a new mask re-fits the value.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: External error; cleared when the user edits.

methods.name: getFormValue
methods.description: Raw or formatted value, per submit.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial value and clear dirty/touched/submitted state.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove rendering, listeners, registration, and subscriptions.

events.name: aui-input
events.description: The raw value changed: { value, formattedValue, complete, validity }.

events.name: aui-change
events.description: Focus left with a changed value.

cssClasses.name: aui-masked-input__input
cssClasses.description: Native input showing the formatted value.
